Dragonite gets Multiscale Dragon Dance with ESpeed coverage, Rotom-Wash pivots with Volt Switch and burns physical attackers, Garchomp leads with Stealth Rock and Rough Skin, and Hatterene brings Magic Bounce plus Trick Room support for slower teammates.</thought>
